definitions.explanation: A person who starts a new business, especially one who takes on financial risk to do so.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{起業家|きぎょうか}が{増|ふ}えている。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{成功|せいこう}した{起業家|きぎょうか}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: She is known as a successful entrepreneur.

examples.japanese: {起業家|きぎょうか}{精神|せいしん}を{持|も}った{人材|じんざい}を{育|そだ}てることが、{地域|ちいき}{経済|けいざい}の{活性化|かっせいか}につながる。
examples.english: Nurturing people with entrepreneurial spirit leads to revitalizing the local economy.

notes:
{起業家|きぎょうか} is composed of {起業|きぎょう} (starting a business) and {家|か} (person/expert). It refers to someone who founds a new business venture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {起業家|きぎょうか}{精神|せいしん} (entrepreneurial spirit)
- {起業家|きぎょうか}{支援|しえん} (entrepreneur support)
- {連続|れんぞく}{起業家|きぎょうか} (serial entrepreneur)
- {社会|しゃかい}{起業家|きぎょうか} (social entrepreneur)

The loanword アントレプレナー is also used, especially in academic and business media contexts, but {起業家|きぎょうか} is more widely understood.
